### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) No-show fee, missed visit 2026-09-19 (Saturday), claim 59de4491.**
- Computation doc (missed_visit_fee_calculation): fee = warranty plan no-show fee × repeat × day × crew, chargeable only when counted missed visits > free count; round once half-up.
- Plan figures (visit_appointment_and_no_show_terms): Lifetime Limited no-show fee 95.00, free count 1.
- Counting period factor (no_show_counting_period): owner holds active CareLine Plus Plan SP-418207 enrolled 2026-05-20 (find_service_plans); waiting period 30 days (service benefit_start schedule: "CareLine Plus Plan | 30") → last waiting day 2026-06-19; 09-19 is after → counted only no-shows dated < 12 whole months before billing date (2026-10-16): 06-25, 07-23, 09-19 = 3 (2023-03-11 excluded). 3 > 1 → chargeable.
- Fee basis factor (no_show_fee_for_service_plan_holders): lower of CareLine plan's no-show fee (service no_show_schedule: "CareLine Plus Plan | 30 minutes | 1 | 59.00") and 95.00 → 59.00.
- Repeat factor (repeat_missed_visit_rate): place 3 − 1 = 2 → second → 1.25.
- Day factor (weekend_missed_visit_rate): 2026-09-19 Saturday → 1.25.
- Crew factor (missed_visit_crew_rate): install job ca0037df "Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap" (find_install_jobs) → 2.0.
- 59 × 1.25 × 1.25 × 2.0 = 184.375 → **184.38**.
- Fall-back (computation doc alone): counted 4 (incl. 2023) > 1, 95 × 1 × 1 × 1 = **95.00** ≠ 184.38.

**(b) Trip charge, visit 2026-10-03 (Saturday, repaired), claim 59de4491.**
- Computation doc (trip_charge_calculation): trip rate × crew × day + access + handling − program discount − missed-visit credit (never below 0), round once. Standard trip = out-of-term trip charge (defect found) = 99.00 (service_visit_rate_card, Lifetime Limited).
- CareLine trip rate factor: active CareLine Plus past waiting period (06-19 < 10-03); plan year 1 (2026-05-20..2027-05-19); repair/glass visits logged in plan year 1: 1 (find_service_calls 2026-08-14 repair_visit); free trips per plan year 0 (service visit_rate_card "CareLine Plus Plan | 69.00 | 0") → no free trip left → rate = min(69.00, 99.00) = 69.00.
- Crew (trip_crew_rate): Full-Frame w/ Exterior Trim Wrap → 2.0. Day (weekend_trip_rate): Saturday → 1.25. → 172.50.
- Access (upper_story_access_surcharge): install activity f0056c82 fee_kind upper_story_surcharge on the job, method not Bay and Bow → ladders 35.00. Handling (build_class_handling_surcharge): factory order d33db5b8 "Specialty Shape Build" → 25.00. Sum 232.50.
- Program discount (trip_program_discount): window contract RW-17-418326 "Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl", discount_program military → "that contract series' military discount rate". **CONDITIONAL**: the series' program rates live in the Window Replacement Contracts product, not yet published; KB_search "Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl military discount rate" returns no window-contract rate card. Record evidence only: the booked 2026-06-04 trip 232.2 = (99×2+35+25)×0.90 is consistent with 10 %. With 10 %: 232.50 × 0.90 = 209.25.
- Missed-visit credit (in computation doc): the visit rebooks the latest missed visit on the same claim, 2026-09-19, 14 days earlier ≤ 30 → credit = no-show fee booked on it = 184.38 (once billed). 209.25 − 184.38 = **24.87** (conditional on the 10 % rate). > 0 → an entry is owed.
- Fall-back: 99 × 1 × 1 + 0 + 0 − 0 − credit; with the fall-back fee 95.00 booked: **4.00**; with the correct fee booked: 0.00 (nothing booked). Either ≠ 24.87.

- Count including 2023-03-11 (place 3 → 1.5): excluded by the counting-period rule for a CareLine holder past waiting period.
- Member rate zero (holder ≥ 12 months): excluded by enrolled 2026-05-20.
- Remaining months 107 (counting the 18th as reached): excluded by "a month being complete once the day of the month of the original coverage start date is reached".
- Open point (policy-side, not decided here): none found beyond the CONDITIONAL military rate.
